heard: Three exhausted astronauts accidentally vanished from NASA's radio. This all-rookie crew faced a brutal minute-by-minute schedule. They fell hours behind while struggling to sleep. The tired men accidentally missed a briefing on Skylab. They spent 90 minutes circling Earth in total silence. Headlines soon claimed the crew had staged a space mutiny. In truth, no strike or intentional revolt ever happened. NASA relaxed the schedule for their record 84-day mission. But none of those three men ever flew again. That legend began when three astronauts vanished from the radio.
